title: Fun Home: A Family Tragicomic
author: Alison Bechdel
summary: Alison Bechdel's graphic memoir about growing up in a funeral home, her complicated relationship with her closeted father, and her own coming out as a lesbian, told in a looping, literary way.
readIf: you like intelligent graphic memoirs about family secrets, sexuality and literature.
skipIf: you want a straightforward linear memoir or a light read.
